curve_rule: solve rational a4,a6 exactly from both centered lifted-point equations; require nonzero discriminant and reduction to the fixed curve at 47
verify: all 1512 rational curves: point equations, smoothness, local coefficient residues, orders 4 and 6, local relation, reduced relation at 47, rational relation, coefficient bit heights
record: compressed per-curve rows, exact source and row hashes, all statuses and first rational-relation witness if present
resource: complete 14*2*2*27 construction; exact arithmetic, no wall-time performance claim
claim_boundary: bounded CRT representative set for the strict local survivors; no inference to all rational coefficients in the same residue classes
